source.source_boundary: Traditional system FRT is failures per million OPHOURS; direct system failures are critical and SystemRepair.DIRPT is fixed turnaround without explicit subtasks.

delta.mechanism: One aircraft gains a system-level operational failure clock and local direct repair at the same workstation base.

configuration.other_faults_pm_resources_and_stock: disabled or absent as in A02 parent

predeclared_native_acceptance: The frozen seed/configuration must produce at least one observed system failure; failure time is read from raw native events, not asserted from seed alone.
Import/export must preserve all nonblank source business rows, conversion errors must be zero, and SXI/SXO/ENLOG/report must be valid and nonempty.

For each observed critical failure, identify the affected aircraft, mission state, repair start and completion; SystemRepair.DIRPT specifies 0.5 h total turnaround unless a documented wait or interruption explains a longer interval.
Reconcile downtime into observed waiting and repair turnaround, mission outcomes, 72 half-hour availability intervals, fault/repair counts and terminal state; compare the fixed no-fault A02 control.
Use session-0 SSH under the host-wide native queue, preserve GUI PID 13340, seal raw hashes and obtain independent read-only replay.
limits: This first slice is a system-level direct repair; an installed component, item replacement and ItemRepair are separate D01 variants and remain unverified.
The fixed seed does not guarantee or prescribe a failure time across model/executable changes; exact times are run-specific evidence.
No resource, inventory, PM, failure-mode, GUI-only or cross-engine behavior is accepted.
